adhkar.ak.tap: Tap each time you say it
adhkar.ak.noteNight: For the evening: the hadith is about reciting them at night.
adhkar.ak.noteLazy: Ten times, or once when you feel tired.
adhkar.ak.noteDay: One hundred times in the day.
adhkar.ak.doneSub: May Allah accept from you and keep you in His care.
adhkar.ak.failed: Could not open the adhkar. Check the connection and try again.
adhkar.du.done.salah: The adhkar after the salah are said
adhkar.du.doneSub.sleep: Rest now. May Allah keep you in His care.
adhkar.du.note.wakeNight: The Prophet ﷺ recited these ayat when he woke in the night.
adhkar.du.note.quls: Three times after Fajr and Maghrib, once after the other prayers.
adhkar.du.note.blow: Hold your palms together, blow lightly into them, recite, then wipe over your body. Three times.
adhkar.du.tapDone: Tap when you have done it
adhkar.du.dawnNext: In the morning, the waking du'a will be waiting with the dawn.
adhkar.bp.title: Bedtime pact
adhkar.bp.start: Start a bedtime pact with family
adhkar.bp.help: Agree with family or friends to say the bedtime du'a for 7 nights together. Nobody is ranked: each night you keep lights a crescent.
adhkar.bp.everyone: Everyone kept all seven nights. Alhamdulillah.
adhkar.bp.shareText: Join my bedtime pact: 7 nights of the bedtime du'a together, in Ayah Studio.
adhkar.bp.bad: This pact link is not valid.
adhkar.bp.inviteTitle: {name} invites you to a bedtime pact
adhkar.bp.inviteSub: Seven nights of the bedtime du'a, together. Each night you say them lights your crescent.
adhkar.bp.closed: This pact has started or is full.
adhkar.bp.signIn: Sign in with Google to join
adhkar.du.notesHelp: A quiet note a few minutes after each adhan, opening its du'a and the adhkar after the salah.
adhkar.du.salahHelp: A quiet note after each salah (12–25 minutes after its time), opening its adhkar.
adhkar.du.salahBody: Your salah is done? Its adhkar are waiting.
adhkar.du.noteBody: Answer it with its du'a. After the salah, the adhkar are waiting.
